procedure.en: There is no zero to find on the outer ring: it is printed 1–11 and 1 is the finest click. The blue inner ring adds micro-adjustment and extends the range to 0 and 12.
procedure.pt-BR: Não há zero a ser encontrado no anel externo: ele é impresso de 1 a 11 e o 1 é o clique mais fino. O anel interno azul acrescenta um ajuste fino e estende a faixa até 0 e 12.

notes: Values are a step index 0–40 on the stepped outer ring: dial number = 1 + floor(index ÷ 4), sub-click = index mod 4 (4 clicks of 0.25 between numbers; 41 positions). Honest Coffee Guide writes decimals (2.5, 8.75); coffeemaster writes x.0–x.3. Conversions: 2.5 = 6, 3–6 = 8–20, 8.75 = 31. The blue inner ring is a second, finer adjustment whose resolution Fellow does not document; it is not modelled here. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope is about 23 µm per outer click ((1160 − 230) ÷ 40), a particle-size estimate, not burr travel. Fellow gear guide: fellowproducts.com/pages/gear-guide-opus.
